analysis.gap_orientation: B0 minus reference in percentage points; positive favors B0
analysis.inference_scope: Approximate variation across task clusters within these suites; not uncertainty over training seeds or a guarantee on unseen tasks. The fixed finite panel score itself is directly observed.
reporting: overall and per-suite counts and rates
analysis.resampling: For each suite in manifest order draw an int64 array (20000,10) of task indices from [0,10), with replacement. Retain all 50 paired outcomes for each sampled task; no independent policy or trial resampling. Sum integer success-count differences across the sampled clusters.
analysis.weighting: equal task and suite weights; equivalent to micro average because every task has 50 trials

authorization: User requested: Can you finish Freeze the acceptance rule before the larger comparison.

change_control.future_runner_preflight: Validate this freeze; emit a new multi-trial protocol and trial-aware HDF5 identities; verify first-pair input parity and resumable host launch before executing the full panel.
change_control.implementation_fix: Record source revision and demonstrate unchanged scientific semantics; preserve any failed attempts and original evidence.
change_control.scientific_change: New version and explicit rationale before new outcomes; preserve old rule and all results.

decision.comparison_precision: unrounded computed endpoints; no display rounding or extra tolerance
decision.fail: upper endpoint of paired 95% gap interval < -5.0 percentage points
decision.failure_or_inconclusive_action: Keep Week 4 gate open; diagnose or propose a separately versioned policy/protocol change. Do not silently relax the margin or select a checkpoint on this panel.
decision.gate_is_passed_only_by: PASS with all validity checks satisfied
decision.incomplete: NOT_ASSESSED until the full panel completes
decision.inconclusive: all other valid completed outcomes; including an interval that straddles -5.0
decision.pass: lower endpoint of paired 95% gap interval >= -5.0 percentage points
decision.validity_first: Require all 2000 identified pairs, verified checkpoint/runtime/task/state/seed provenance, valid outcome evidence, and matched initial raw observations; unresolved infrastructure or provenance issues yield NOT_ASSESSABLE.
week4_closure_also_requires: final B0 and protocol evidence freeze

outcome_accounting.exhausted_infrastructure_failure: Keep scheduled episode in denominator with outcome 0, preserve attempt evidence, and withhold scientific acceptance as NOT_ASSESSABLE until infrastructure validity is resolved.
outcome_accounting.missing_pair_or_unverified_artifact: NOT_ASSESSABLE; never drop the pair or shrink denominator.

b0.selection: Epoch 5, selected by frozen validation objective; no selection on clean outcomes.

pre_observation_disclosure.interpretation: Prospective larger-panel rule after a disclosed pilot; not a blinded or wholly unseen test. State 0 remains in the fixed 50-state inventory.

rollout_contract.execution_order: B0 then reference; canonical suite/task/trial order within each policy; no concurrent GPU policies.

scope.gate: Week 4 operational clean-performance readiness against a fixed external reference
scope.later_controlled_experiments: B0 remains the shared initialization and matched training control for later project models.
scope.roadmap_revision: Replace the undefined configuration-matched public comparator for this operational gate with the pinned installed external reference; retain the five-percentage-point maximum deficit and add a paired uncertainty requirement.
